units.title: Linear Systems
units.blurb: Solve systems with row reduction and describe all their solutions.

units.title: Vectors and Matrix Equations
units.blurb: Combine vectors, describe spans, and test independence.

units.title: Linear Transformations
units.blurb: Describe linear maps by matrices and see their geometry.

units.title: Determinants
units.blurb: Compute determinants and see them as volume scale factors.

units.title: Vector Spaces
units.blurb: Generalize to vector spaces, subspaces, bases, dimension and change of basis.

units.title: Eigenvalues and Eigenvectors
units.blurb: Find the directions a matrix only stretches, and diagonalize.

units.title: Orthogonality and Least Squares
units.blurb: Project onto subspaces, build orthonormal bases, and fit data by least squares.

units.title: Symmetric Matrices and the SVD
units.blurb: Diagonalize symmetric matrices, study quadratic forms, and use the SVD.

topics.title: Linear Systems and Their Pictures
topics.short: See a system as intersecting lines and planes, or as combining columns.

topics.title: Augmented Matrices and Row Operations
topics.short: Swap, scale and add rows without changing the solutions.
topics.trouble: Students multiply a row by 0, subtract a row from itself, or copy one row over another, which throws away an equation and can change the solution set.

topics.title: Gaussian Elimination and Echelon Form
topics.short: Clear entries below each pivot.
topics.trouble: Students make arithmetic slips with fractions and never check by substitution.

topics.title: Reduced Row Echelon Form
topics.short: Make every pivot 1 with zeros above and below.

topics.title: Free Variables and Parametric Solutions
topics.short: Write every solution in terms of the free variables.
topics.trouble: Students set free variables to 0 and report one solution as if it were all of them.

topics.title: When Solutions Exist and Are Unique
topics.short: Read the answer from the pivot positions.
topics.trouble: Students think a row of zeros always means no solution.

topics.title: Vectors in Rⁿ and Linear Combinations
topics.short: Scale and add vectors to reach new ones.

topics.title: Span
topics.short: The span is every linear combination of a set of vectors.
topics.trouble: Students think two vectors in R³ span all of R³.

topics.title: The Matrix Equation Ax = b
topics.short: Ax is a combination of the columns of A.
topics.trouble: Students compute Ax with rows of x, or mismatch sizes.

topics.title: Homogeneous Systems
topics.short: Ax = 0 always has the zero solution; the question is whether there are others.

topics.title: Linear Independence
topics.short: No vector in the set is a combination of the others.
topics.trouble: Students check only pairs of vectors for being multiples, missing dependence among three.

topics.title: Matrix Operations and Transposes
topics.short: Add, multiply and transpose, minding the order.
topics.trouble: Students assume AB = BA, or write (AB)ᵀ = AᵀBᵀ.

topics.title: Inverses by Gauss–Jordan
topics.short: Row-reduce A next to I until A becomes I; then I has become A⁻¹.
topics.trouble: Students write (AB)⁻¹ = A⁻¹B⁻¹ instead of B⁻¹A⁻¹.

topics.title: The Invertible Matrix Theorem
topics.short: Many statements about a square matrix are all true or all false together.

topics.title: Elementary Matrices and LU Factorization
topics.short: Record elimination as A = LU.

topics.title: Linear Transformations
topics.short: T(u + v) = T(u) + T(v) and T(cu) = cT(u).
topics.trouble: Students call a translation linear, though it moves the zero vector.

topics.title: The Matrix of a Linear Transformation
topics.short: The columns are the images of the standard basis vectors.
topics.trouble: Students write the images as rows instead of columns.

topics.title: Rotations, Reflections, Shears and Projections
topics.short: Read and build matrices for common plane maps.

topics.title: Composition as Matrix Multiplication
topics.short: Doing S after T has matrix ST.
topics.trouble: Students multiply in the order the maps are applied, getting TS.

topics.title: One-to-One and Onto
topics.short: Pivots in every column mean one-to-one; in every row mean onto.

topics.title: Determinants by Cofactor Expansion
topics.short: Expand along any row or column.
topics.trouble: Students forget the checkerboard of signs.

topics.title: Properties of Determinants
topics.short: Row operations change the determinant in predictable ways; det(AB) = det A det B.
topics.trouble: Students assume det(A + B) = det A + det B.

topics.title: Determinants as Area and Volume
topics.short: |det A| is the factor by which A scales area or volume.

topics.title: Cramer's Rule and the Adjugate
topics.short: Solve small systems and invert with determinants.

topics.title: Writing Short Proofs
topics.short: Prove statements from definitions, one justified step at a time.
topics.trouble: Students check one example and call it a proof.

topics.title: Vector Spaces and Subspaces
topics.short: A subspace contains 0 and is closed under addition and scaling.
topics.trouble: Students forget to check that the zero vector is in the set.

topics.title: Null Space and Column Space
topics.short: Nul A solves Ax = 0; Col A is the span of the columns.
topics.trouble: Students take the pivot columns of the reduced matrix instead of the original A as a basis for Col A.

topics.title: Bases
topics.short: A basis spans and is independent.

topics.title: Dimension and Rank
topics.short: Every basis has the same size; rank is the dimension of the column space.

topics.title: The Rank–Nullity Theorem and the Four Subspaces
topics.short: rank + nullity = number of columns.

topics.title: Coordinates and Change of Basis
topics.short: Describe vectors in a new basis with a change-of-coordinates matrix.
topics.trouble: Students use the change-of-basis matrix in the wrong direction.

topics.title: Eigenvectors and Eigenvalues
topics.short: Av = λv: A only stretches v.
topics.trouble: Students accept the zero vector as an eigenvector.

topics.title: The Characteristic Equation
topics.short: Solve det(A − λI) = 0.
topics.trouble: Students subtract λ from every entry instead of only the diagonal.

topics.title: Eigenspaces and Multiplicity
topics.short: Each eigenvalue has a space of eigenvectors.

topics.title: Diagonalization
topics.short: A = PDP⁻¹ when there are enough independent eigenvectors.
topics.trouble: Students think a repeated eigenvalue always prevents diagonalizing, or never does.

topics.title: Matrix Powers and Markov Chains
topics.short: Use Aᵏ = PDᵏP⁻¹ and find steady states.

topics.title: Complex Eigenvalues
topics.short: Complex eigenvalues signal rotation.

topics.title: Similar Matrices
topics.short: Similar matrices describe the same map in different bases.

topics.title: Length and Orthogonality in Rⁿ
topics.short: Vectors are orthogonal when their dot product is 0.

topics.title: Orthogonal Complements
topics.short: Row space and null space are perpendicular.

topics.title: Orthogonal Projections
topics.short: Find the closest point in a subspace.
topics.trouble: Students project onto a non-orthogonal basis one vector at a time and add.

topics.title: Gram–Schmidt and QR
topics.short: Turn any basis into an orthonormal one.

topics.title: Least Squares
topics.short: Solve AᵀAx̂ = Aᵀb to fit data.
topics.trouble: Students solve Ax = b directly when it has no solution.

topics.title: Orthogonal Matrices
topics.short: QᵀQ = I: rotations and reflections preserve length.

topics.title: Symmetric Matrices and the Spectral Theorem
topics.short: A symmetric matrix has an orthonormal basis of eigenvectors.

topics.title: Quadratic Forms and Positive Definite Matrices
topics.short: xᵀAx > 0 for all x ≠ 0 exactly when all eigenvalues are positive.

topics.title: The Singular Value Decomposition
topics.short: A = UΣVᵀ for every matrix.
topics.trouble: Students take singular values to be the eigenvalues of A instead of the square roots of the eigenvalues of AᵀA.

topics.title: Low-Rank Approximation and Applications
topics.short: Keep the largest singular values to compress data.
